newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks open solidly higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks open solidly higher.

text.p: U.S. stocks opened broadly higher on Friday after the release of reassuring September producer price and strong retail sales data.
The Dow industrials average rose 17 to 5,939 at the start of trade. The NASDAQ Index was up six to 1,243, while the S&P Index rose two to 697.
The long bond was up 23/32 to yield 6.83 percent.
